DS_REFUSED_BASE64_NONCANONICAL.condition: the payload or a signature is not canonical standard base64: wrong alphabet, missing or excess padding, non-zero pad bits, or trailing data
DS_REFUSED_BASE64_NONCANONICAL.prevents: that two different encodings of the same bytes are both accepted, or that bytes are recovered from a non-canonical encoding

DS_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_KEY.condition: the envelope's JSON contains a duplicated object key
DS_REFUSED_DUPLICATE_KEY.prevents: that a second payloadType, payload or sig is silently discarded and a different field is the one verified

DS_REFUSED_ENVELOPE_INVALID.condition: the envelope is not a JSON object with exactly payloadType, payload and signatures, or a field has the wrong JSON type
DS_REFUSED_ENVELOPE_INVALID.prevents: that an array, a bare payload, an unknown top-level field or a non-string field is read as a DSSE envelope

DS_REFUSED_OBJECT_SUPPLIED.condition: verification was given a parsed object or decoded text instead of the received bytes
DS_REFUSED_OBJECT_SUPPLIED.prevents: that a caller's in-memory representation, which has lost the received byte identity, is verified as those bytes

DS_REFUSED_PAE_LENGTH.condition: a PAE byte string declares a type or body length that does not match its bytes, or uses a non-canonical decimal
DS_REFUSED_PAE_LENGTH.prevents: that a PAE with a wrong length prefix is read as the concatenation it claims to be

DS_REFUSED_PAE_RESERIALISED.condition: the PAE body is not the decoded payload bytes, or the signature verifies only over a canonical re-encoding of the payload
DS_REFUSED_PAE_RESERIALISED.prevents: that a payload parsed and re-encoded before verification is accepted as the payload that was signed

DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_ABSENT.condition: the envelope has no payload field
DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_ABSENT.prevents: that an envelope with no payload is verified against an empty byte string

DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_NOT_STATEMENT.condition: a statement is required and the verified payload is not a structurally valid in-toto Statement v1 (A9)
DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_NOT_STATEMENT.prevents: that a structurally valid envelope over arbitrary bytes is read as an in-toto attestation

DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_TYPE_MISMATCH.condition: verification is bound to an expected payload type and the received payloadType is not it
DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_TYPE_MISMATCH.prevents: that a payload signed under one type is verified or read as another (a generic payload read as a statement, or a statement as a generic payload)

DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_TYPE_MISSING.condition: the envelope has no payloadType field
DS_REFUSED_PAYLOAD_TYPE_MISSING.prevents: that a payload is verified with a default or inferred type, so the signed type boundary is lost

DS_REFUSED_SIGNATURES_ABSENT.condition: the envelope has no signatures field, or the list is empty
DS_REFUSED_SIGNATURES_ABSENT.prevents: that an unsigned payload is read as a signed one

DS_REFUSED_SIGNATURE_INVALID.condition: no supplied signature verifies over the PAE of the received bytes
DS_REFUSED_SIGNATURE_INVALID.prevents: that a payload whose bytes, type or signature changed is accepted

DS_REFUSED_TRAILING_BYTES.condition: the envelope bytes carry data after the JSON value
DS_REFUSED_TRAILING_BYTES.prevents: that a second document appended to an envelope is ignored while the first is verified
